metadata.name: Fully Updated Production Dog Diet Recommendation Knowledge Base
metadata.description: Breed-specific dog diet recommendation knowledge base with standardized diet plans, numeric nutrient guidance, food safety rules, supplement guidance, transition guidance, and monitoring advice.

Maintenance.dietary_recommendations: Similar to Labrador, a balanced adult maintenance diet with quality protein and moderate fat. Golden Retrievers are prone to obesity, so control portions and ensure regular exercise. Include omega-3s for skin and coat health.
homemade_food_options: Boiled chicken or turkey with brown rice and vegetables, plus a multivitamin supplement
Lean beef with sweet potato and peas, fortified with calcium (dairy or supplement)
Maintenance.diet_goal: maintain ideal body condition and stable energy

calorie_adjustment.low: Use smaller food portions and lower-fat ingredients.
calorie_adjustment.medium: Use the listed balanced serving pattern.
calorie_adjustment.high: Use larger portions or energy-dense ingredients from the plan.

portion_and_calorie_guidance.portion_rule: Divide the listed daily food amount into the listed meals per day.

meal_timing_guidance.meal_spacing: Keep meals at consistent times; avoid sudden large meals.
meal_timing_guidance.bloat_precaution: For large/giant breeds, avoid heavy exercise immediately before/after meals and split food into smaller meals.

preparation_rules: cook meat/eggs thoroughly unless using a vet-formulated raw plan
remove bones and excess fat
do not season with onion/garlic/salt-heavy spices
introduce new foods gradually
food_safety.treat_limit: Treats should be ≤10% of daily calories.

allergy_and_sensitivity_rules.protein_rotation: Use alternative proteins if itching, vomiting, diarrhea, or chronic ear/skin issues appear.
allergy_and_sensitivity_rules.limited_ingredient_option: For suspected allergies, use a single novel or hydrolyzed protein diet under veterinary guidance.
allergy_and_sensitivity_rules.gi_monitoring: Track stool quality, gas, vomiting, and appetite after diet changes.

supplement_guidance.multivitamin_mineral: Required for long-term homemade diets unless formulated by a veterinary nutritionist.
supplement_guidance.omega_3: Useful for skin, coat, inflammation, and joints; dose should be weight-appropriate.
supplement_guidance.joint_support: Consider glucosamine/chondroitin/MSM for senior, large, giant, or joint-prone breeds.
supplement_guidance.probiotics: Optional for sensitive digestion or after antibiotic use.
supplement_guidance.calcium_warning: Do not add calcium randomly to complete commercial food; balance calcium/phosphorus carefully in homemade diets.

transition_plan.day_7_plus: 100% new food if stool and appetite are normal

monitoring_metrics.weight_tracking: Track weight weekly for gain/loss diets and monthly for maintenance.
monitoring_metrics.stool_score: Monitor stool consistency; persistent diarrhea/constipation requires review.

Weight Loss.dietary_recommendations: Use a high-protein, high-fiber weight loss diet. As with Labradors, weight control is important in Goldens. Feed fewer calories and increase activity.
Weight Loss.hydration: Fresh water ad lib; high-fiber foods may increase thirst
homemade_food_options: Lean protein (chicken or fish) with vegetables and fiber, supplemented with calcium and vitamins
Weight Loss.diet_goal: reduce body fat while preserving lean muscle

Puppy Diet.dietary_recommendations: Small-breed puppy formula with balanced calcium. High protein and fat. 3–4 meals/day to meet high energy needs of growth.
Puppy Diet.hydration: Fresh water available; ensure hydration after play
homemade_food_options: Boiled chicken with rice and veggies, puppy vitamins
Ground turkey with peas and pumpkin, plus calcium supplement
breed_specific_considerations: monitor body condition and stool quality

calorie_adjustment.low: Use smaller food portions and lower-fat ingredients.
calorie_adjustment.medium: Use the listed balanced serving pattern.
calorie_adjustment.high: Use larger portions or energy-dense ingredients from the plan.

portion_and_calorie_guidance.portion_rule: Divide the listed daily food amount into the listed meals per day.

meal_timing_guidance.meal_spacing: Keep meals at consistent times; avoid sudden large meals.
meal_timing_guidance.bloat_precaution: Use small, measured meals; avoid free-feeding if weight gain occurs.

preparation_rules: cook meat/eggs thoroughly unless using a vet-formulated raw plan
remove bones and excess fat
do not season with onion/garlic/salt-heavy spices
introduce new foods gradually
food_safety.treat_limit: Treats should be ≤10% of daily calories.

allergy_and_sensitivity_rules.protein_rotation: Use alternative proteins if itching, vomiting, diarrhea, or chronic ear/skin issues appear.
allergy_and_sensitivity_rules.limited_ingredient_option: For suspected allergies, use a single novel or hydrolyzed protein diet under veterinary guidance.
allergy_and_sensitivity_rules.gi_monitoring: Track stool quality, gas, vomiting, and appetite after diet changes.

supplement_guidance.multivitamin_mineral: Required for long-term homemade diets unless formulated by a veterinary nutritionist.
supplement_guidance.omega_3: Useful for skin, coat, inflammation, and joints; dose should be weight-appropriate.
supplement_guidance.joint_support: Consider glucosamine/chondroitin/MSM for senior, large, giant, or joint-prone breeds.
supplement_guidance.probiotics: Optional for sensitive digestion or after antibiotic use.
supplement_guidance.calcium_warning: Do not add calcium randomly to complete commercial food; balance calcium/phosphorus carefully in homemade diets.
